entities.name: Serfdom, Herrnhuters & Emancipation
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Gutswirtschaft system of Baltic German serfdom, the Moravian Brethren (Herrnhuter) movement bringing literacy and religious awakening to Latvian peasants, the emancipation laws of 1817 (Courland) and 1819 (Vidzeme) freeing peasants without land, and gradual land reform.
